reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is accurate but spec requirement is misapplied. The flagged function publish_column_sidecars() (L500-531) is part of the HTTP API for block producers (validators submitting their own blocks), not the gossip redistribution path. The spec's SG-010 'distributed_blob_publishing' with INV-002 'Publishing only occurs on subscribed subnets' applies to the gossip redistribution scenario (receive block from gossip → fetch blobs from EL via engine_getBlobsV2 → publish columns), which is a different code path. For block producers, the spec SG-006 'sidecar_publishing' requires publishing ALL sidecars to their respective subnets without custody/sampling filtering—exactly what the code does. The provenance field shows this handles 'local' or 'builder' blocks, not gossip-received blocks. Spec-compliant by-design behavior for validator block publishing.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-006 (fulu-validator/sidecar_publishing) mandates block producers publish all sidecars. SG-010 INV-002 applies only to gossip redistribution, not block production.
